# Wikipedia HTML snapshot attribution

The three HTML snapshots are unmodified copies collected on 2026-10-05 to test document structure. They are third-party content, not MIT-licensed plugin code. Full original HTML, including the source's revision and attribution metadata, is retained.

- `wikipedia-knowledge-graph.html`: Wikipedia contributors, [Knowledge Graph](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Knowledge_Graph), [author and revision history](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Knowledge_Graph&action=history).
- `wikipedia-google-knowledge-graph.html`: Wikipedia contributors, [Knowledge Graph (Google)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Knowledge_Graph_(Google)), [author and revision history](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Knowledge_Graph_(Google)&action=history).
- `wikipedia-neuroscience.html`: Wikipedia contributors, [Neuroscience](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neuroscience), [author and revision history](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Neuroscience&action=history).

Wikipedia article text is available under [Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/) and may have additional applicable source terms; images and other embedded material retain their own licenses. See [Wikipedia copyright terms](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Copyrights) and each original source. No images are downloaded for these fixtures; the HTML retains references to original resources. These snapshots are distributed only with source tests.

Retrieval timestamps and SHA-256 hashes: [parsing-quality.md](../../docs/parsing-quality.md).
